name: Hilton Worldwide
outlook:
What Hilton Worldwide says to expect

  • Fourth quarter 2026: system-wide RevPARSystem-wide comparable RevPAR, on a currency neutral basis, is projected to increase between 3.0 percent and 3.5 percent compared to the fourth quarter of 2025.
  • Fourth quarter 2026: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA is projected to be between $1,047 million and $1,067 million.
  • Full year 2026: system-wide RevPARSystem-wide comparable RevPAR, on a currency neutral basis, is projected to increase between 4.0 percent and 4.5 percent compared to 2025.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted EBITDAAdjusted EBITDA is projected to be between $4,060 million and $4,080 million, which incorporates lower expectations for performance in the Middle East and timeshare license fees compared to our prior guidance.
  • Full year 2026: adjusted diluted earnings per shareDiluted EPS, adjusted for special items, is projected to be between $9.07 and $9.13.
The company's own words, from its earnings release (Form 8-K, Exhibit 99), filed October 27, 2026. They are its expectations, not ours, and not a forecast or price target from The Filing Desk. Replaced when the next release is out.
